# Continuation Discovery — 2026-08-28

The Awtsmoos renews each frame and fact, so yesterday cannot stand alone;
Awtsmoos.com must read the living tree before a single vessel is called its own.

## Observed architecture
- `apps/shared/movie/` is now the canonical interchange and AI-authoring layer.
- `libs/awtsmoos-movie-core/` is the deterministic lower-level timeline/render layer.
- `showcase/unified-movie-180/` proves shared-to-core interoperability.
- Animator exposes canonical export/media verification work while Nesher, Video Editor, Mitzvah Studio, and Captions retain distinct capability profiles.

## Concrete defect discovered
`MovieIntentNormalizer.normalizeScene()` computes `dimension = scene.dimension || "hybrid"` but does not preserve that resolved dimension in its return object, and entity adaptation receives the pre-default scene. Dimensionless AI scenes therefore lose the intended hybrid semantic and can map characters, shapes, and particles to the wrong 2D kinds.

## Remaining discovery
1. Read the canonical schema validator and semantic kinds.
2. Trace shared/core bridge and low-level timeline evaluator.
3. Inspect the 180-second showcase movie data and browser renderer.
4. Trace each studio's shared-movie import/adapter path.
5. Inspect export/media probe capability before claiming a rendered artifact.

## First safe ownership target
Rewrite `apps/shared/movie/ai/MovieIntentNormalizer.js` whole-file after one final fresh read, preserving its public export and fixing resolved-dimension propagation. Add a new focused regression test rather than rewriting concurrent studio code.
